skills.name: map-gl-accounts
skills.title: Map GL Accounts to the Chart of Accounts
skills.description: Map SKU.io's accounting roles (sales, COGS, inventory, AR, AP, sales tax and more) to the customer's QuickBooks Online or Xero accounts, and save only after explicit approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Map GL accounts" step or when journals fail for a missing nominal code mapping.
skills.tagline: Map SKU.io's GL roles onto the customer's QuickBooks or Xero accounts, with sign-off

skills.name: map-product-accounts
skills.title: Map Product Accounts with Account Rules
skills.description: Turn a customer's per-product GL spreadsheet into a few SKU.io account rules (by category, brand, supplier or product type), keep true exceptions as product overrides, and save only after explicit approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Map GL accounts" step or a product GL sheet.
skills.tagline: Turn a per-product GL sheet into a few account rules, with sign-off

skills.name: reconcile-supplier-statement
skills.title: Reconcile a Supplier Statement
skills.description: Reconcile a supplier's statement and the bank payments to them against SKU.io's bills, credits and payments, explain every difference, and fix the SKU.io side with approval. Use for "does our statement from X match", "why does SKU.io say we owe X more", or a regular supplier reconciliation.
skills.tagline: Match a supplier's statement and bank payments to SKU.io's payables, and fix the gaps

skills.name: record-vendor-credit
skills.title: Record a Vendor Credit
skills.description: Record a supplier credit memo (vendor credit, credit note) from the PDF or email and apply it to the open bill it reduces. For non-inventory credits such as co-op or advertising credits, rebates, allowances and overbilling. Returned goods and PO price corrections are routed elsewhere.
skills.tagline: Record a supplier credit memo and apply it to an open bill

skills.name: manage-amazon-recovery
skills.title: Manage Amazon Recovery Cases
skills.description: Work Amazon FBA reimbursement claims from SKU.io's Amazon Recovery: triage found cases, file them in Seller Central with SKU.io's filing pack, and record Amazon's answers and appeals. Use to file, chase or clean up claims for lost or damaged inventory, inbound shortages or FBA fee overcharges.
skills.tagline: Triage, file and follow up on Amazon reimbursement claims

skills.name: optimize-tiktok-listing-quality
skills.title: Optimize TikTok Shop Listing Quality
skills.description: Fix TikTok Shop listings rated POOR or FAIR toward GOOD from TikTok's own diagnosis: rewrite titles and descriptions, source better images, and apply only after review. Use for "fix our TikTok listing quality", "get these POOR listings to GOOD", or "why are these listings rated FAIR".
skills.tagline: Diagnose and fix POOR/FAIR TikTok Shop listings toward GOOD, reviewed before it lands

skills.name: adjust-inventory
skills.title: Adjust Inventory
skills.description: Adjust the on-hand quantity of a product at a warehouse in SKU.io — an increase, a decrease, or a set-to-value. Use this for stock takes, corrections, damage/shrinkage write-offs, or found stock. Resolve the product with find-product first so the adjustment targets the right product and warehouse.
skills.tagline: Increase / decrease / set on-hand stock at a warehouse

skills.name: set-initial-inventory
skills.title: Set Initial Inventory
skills.description: Load opening stock into SKU.io as a first-ever count per warehouse, dated to the inventory start date, with unit costs, and report rows it could not resolve. Use when going live, onboarding a warehouse or 3PL, or importing an opening count sheet. For later counts or corrections use adjust-inventory.
skills.tagline: Load opening stock per warehouse as an initial count on the inventory start date

skills.name: build-boms
skills.title: Build Bills of Materials from a Recipe Sheet
skills.description: Create bills of materials (BOMs, recipes) for manufactured products from the user's recipe sheet, after approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Bills of materials" step, when onboarding a manufacturer, or when a manufactured product has no recipe. Never edits or deletes an existing BOM.
skills.tagline: Create BOMs for manufactured products from the user's recipe sheet

skills.name: create-sales-order
skills.title: Create a Sales Order
skills.description: Create a sales order in SKU.io with one or more line items: status, date, currency, optional customer and store, and the SKUs, quantities and prices sold. Use to place an order for a customer. Resolve products first with find-product.
skills.tagline: Create a sales order with line items

skills.name: connect-to-sku
skills.title: Connect to SKU.io
skills.description: The entry point for any SKU.io API task: set the tenant base URL, send a Personal Access Token as a Bearer token, and verify with GET /api/me that the tenant and token scopes are right before any other call. Use first whenever you are about to call the SKU.io API.
skills.tagline: Authenticate, verify the token and tenant, and establish scopes before anything else

skills.name: create-saved-view
skills.title: Create a Saved View (and favorite it)
skills.description: Create and favorite a saved view on any SKU.io data table (products, sales orders, inventory, …): a named set of columns, filters, sort and search. Use to give a user a one-click way back to a slice of data, such as a fresh import or an exception queue. Other skills call it too.
skills.tagline: Create and favorite a saved view — columns, filters, sort — on any data table

skills.name: create-workflow
skills.title: Create a Workflow (automation)
skills.description: Build, test, publish and fix automation workflows: email or Slack alerts when an order lands on a channel, tag or note orders by rule, post a webhook, import a supplier feed on a schedule, or route orders to a warehouse. Use when something should happen automatically, or a workflow did not fire.
skills.tagline: Build, validate, publish and test an automation workflow from a node/edge graph

skills.name: follow-launch-roadmap
skills.title: Follow the Launch Roadmap
skills.description: Work through an account's SKU.io Launch Roadmap with the user: pick the next unblocked steps, explain each, hand off to the matching skill to do it, and record progress. Use for "what's next on our launch?", "help me with my onboarding steps", or when the user names a roadmap step.
skills.tagline: Pick your next Launch Roadmap steps and work them with the matching skill

skills.name: sync-sops
skills.title: Sync your SOPs with SKU.io changes
skills.description: Keep internal SOPs in step with SKU.io: compare your SOP content against SKU.io's changelog and docs since your last review, and rewrite the stale steps or draft a new SOP in your format. Use when internal docs or SOPs may be out of date, or on a schedule to catch drift.
skills.tagline: Reconcile your internal SOPs against what changed in SKU.io — automatically

skills.name: build-product-catalog
skills.title: Build a Product Catalog from Any Source
skills.description: Import products into SKU.io from a spreadsheet, CSV, Google Sheet, supplier price list, web page or pasted text: map the fields, de-duplicate against the catalog, then create them. Use to onboard a new catalog, import a supplier's range, or bulk-load products from another system.
skills.tagline: Import products from a spreadsheet, price list, web page, or pasted text

skills.name: configure-bundles
skills.title: Configure Bundles and Kits
skills.description: Add components to bundle and kit products that have none, from the user's component sheet or the channel listing titles, after approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Configure kits & bundles" step, after importing multi-pack or set listings, or when kits or bundles show no components.
skills.tagline: Turn bundle and kit listings into products with real components

skills.name: enrich-channel-content
skills.title: Enrich Product Content for a Sales Channel
skills.description: Write the channel-specific product descriptions a marketplace needs (e.g. tiktokshop_description) from existing copy, with an HTML review report; only approved copy is saved. Use when products can't list on TikTok Shop, Walmart or Temu because descriptions are missing or break channel rules.
skills.tagline: Amalgamate existing copy into channel-correct descriptions, reviewed before it lands

skills.name: find-matrix-opportunities
skills.title: Find Matrix (Variant) Product Opportunities
skills.description: Find standalone products that are really one product in several sizes, colours or styles, check them against Amazon variation data, and optionally group them into matrix (variant) products. Use when asked which products should be variants, or why size/colour products are listed one by one.
skills.tagline: Spot size/colour families hiding in a flat catalog and group them into matrix products

skills.name: find-product
skills.title: Find a Product
skills.description: Look up a product in the SKU.io catalog by SKU, barcode, or a free-text search over name and SKU. Use this whenever you need to resolve a product reference to its SKU.io product record and id — for example before adding it to a sales order, checking stock, or reporting on it.
skills.tagline: Resolve a product by SKU, barcode, or fuzzy search

skills.name: map-supplier-costs
skills.title: Map Supplier Costs onto Reorderable Products
skills.description: Fill in missing supplier costs for reorderable products from the user's supplier price lists or past purchase orders, after approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Supplier costs" step or products with no supplier pricing. For a new price file on products that have costs, use update-catalog-pricing.
skills.tagline: Fill missing supplier costs from price lists or past purchase orders

skills.name: publish-listing
skills.title: Publish or Update a Channel Listing
skills.description: List a product on a sales channel (Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, TikTok Shop, Temu, Faire) or revise a live listing: pick the category, map required fields, validate, publish and follow the result. Use whenever a product should be listed, re-listed or its listing updated.
skills.tagline: Draft, validate, and publish a listing to any sales channel

skills.name: update-catalog-pricing
skills.title: Update Catalog Pricing from a Price File
skills.description: Apply a new price file to existing products: match rows by SKU, supplier SKU, MPN or barcode, show old vs new, confirm, then update supplier costs and/or selling prices. Use when a supplier sends new pricing or a range is repriced. Never creates products (that is build-product-catalog).
skills.tagline: Apply a supplier's new price file to the existing catalog

skills.name: create-purchase-order
skills.title: Create a Purchase Order
skills.description: Create a purchase order with a supplier from a plain description or a source document (supplier email, order form, demand-plan export): resolve supplier, warehouse, costs and lines, and create it as a draft or open order. Use to reorder stock, including consignment replenishment.
skills.tagline: Create a replenishment PO for a supplier from a description or document

skills.name: record-purchase-invoice
skills.title: Record a Purchase Invoice
skills.description: Record a supplier invoice (bill) against a purchase order from the invoice PDF, email or a description: map lines and freight, check for duplicates, attach the document, and verify with a three-way match. Also corrects an existing bill that differs from the supplier's invoice, and records payment.
skills.tagline: Record a supplier invoice against a PO from the invoice document

skills.name: edit-packing-slip-template
skills.title: Edit a Packing-Slip PDF Template
skills.description: Edit a packing-slip PDF template with the rules that keep the footer banner, logo and per-store layouts consistent. Use when changing a packing slip's banner or branding, or when the banner is missing or clipped on some orders or stores. Builds on edit-pdf-template.
skills.tagline: Edit packing-slip templates without breaking the footer banner

skills.name: edit-pdf-template
skills.title: Edit a PDF Template
skills.description: Edit any SKU.io PDF template (packing slips, quotes, sales orders, pick lists, purchase orders, credits) by editing its HTML, then validate, preview and visually check the PDF before saving. Use to change branding, layout, a logo, a footer banner or which fields a document shows.
skills.tagline: Edit, preview, and visually QA any PDF document template — safely
